title_zh: 确定汤的调味并安排分装剩余份量

scenario.label_zh: 分工煮汤并安排剩余份量
scenario.goal_zh: 确定汤的配料、调味与口感，分配烹饪工作并约定保存多余份量

context_zh: 合住的朋友分工准备晚餐汤品，并安排保存多余份量。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Poppy
sentences.text: The soup has a good flavour already. Should we leave out the extra salt?

sentences.speaker: Harris
sentences.text: Yes. I will stir in the cooked beans, and you can chop the parsley.

sentences.speaker: Poppy
sentences.text: Do you want it smooth, or should we keep the pieces of carrot?

sentences.speaker: Harris
sentences.text: Let us keep the pieces. There is enough here for four portions, and only two of us are eating.

sentences.speaker: Poppy
sentences.text: Then we can serve half now and put the rest in two labelled containers for the fridge.

sentences.speaker: Harris
sentences.text: Agreed. I will get the containers ready while you finish the parsley.
